system.description: You see the work that built this place: the aether-lines that hold it up, the point where one precise blow does what a hundred shouldn't. You always have access to basic masonry tools (chisel, mallet, iron spike, measuring line) without tracking them as inventory. When contributing to a clock related to structural construction or demolition, fill one additional segment.
